description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different diffusion steps on text generation quality, as measured on XSum. The horizontal axis represents the diffusion step, with values ranging from 100 to 2000. The vertical axis indicates the quality score, with values ranging from approximately 0 to 45. The chart includes three sets of bars, each representing a different method: ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L. The ROUGE-1 bars, shown in light blue, indicate the highest quality scores, with the shortest bar at 100 diffusion steps and the tallest at 2000 steps. The ROUGE-2 bars, in orange, show a similar trend but with slightly lower scores. The ROUGE-L bars, in light blue with a diagonal stripe pattern, have the lowest scores across all diffusion steps. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
